title: Hezbollah chief calls Israeli election results a form of defeat, rejects disarmament
detail: Aggregated headline reports the Hezbollah leader describing the outcome of Israel's election as a form of defeat and reiterating rejection of disarmament. Single headline; details not independently confirmed.

title: Israeli army strikes Deir Mimas in southern Lebanon
